highlights: Adding several photos at once now keeps all of them. On Android the phone was releasing its hold on the files while they waited to upload, so a batch of ten could arrive as one — the photos are now copied the moment you pick them, and any that can't be read are named right away instead of failing later.
A photo you moved to a different plant no longer keeps showing as the cover photo on the crop screen you moved it away from.
Tall pop-up panels no longer push their top edge off the screen when they're full of content.
